objects.description: [HTTPTroy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9007) has obfuscated HTTP POST request communications utilizing XOR with a designated key of 0x56, followed by Base64 encoding.(Citation: Gen Digital Kimsuky HTTPTroy October 2025)
objects.description_fa: [HTTPTtroy](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9007) ارتباطات درخواست HTTP POST را با استفاده از XOR با کلید تعیین‌شده 0x56 و به دنبال آن کدگذاری Base64 مبهم کرده است.(Citation: Gen Digital Kimsuky HTTPTroy October 2025)
